# Telemetry reference

These are the events Orion sends once someone opts in to sharing anonymous usage data, and nothing else. Without that choice, it sends nothing.

Events hold counts, durations, and the names of Orion's own commands and features. They never hold titles, notes, refs, repository names, URLs, file paths, or option values. Every event also carries the version, commit, and channel of the build that sent it, and events from the app carry a session id that runs from launch to quit.

The same list is published as [JSON](/reference/telemetry.json), which the telemetry service checks every event against. It drops any event or property that isn't listed.

Nothing goes straight from the app, a command, or an agent to the network. Events wait in a small queue in Orion's data folder, and `orion server start`, which the app runs, sends them periodically. A batch that can't be sent is dropped, never retried. Setting `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` or `ORION_TELEMETRY=0` keeps everything off whatever was chosen, and a machine that isn't sharing keeps nothing to send later. Dev builds, perf runs, and CI never send.

## Consent

Sent once, when someone opts in. Opting out sends nothing.

### telemetry_opted_in

Someone chose to share usage data, in the app's dialog or its settings, or with the CLI. Sent by the app and the CLI.

| Property  | Type   | Description                                     |
| --------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `surface` | string | Where the choice was made. One of `app`, `cli`. |

## Performance

How long Orion takes to draw, lay out, and save, so slow spots can be found and tracked across releases.

### app_started

The app opened and drew its first canvas. Sent by the app.

| Property     | Type    | Description                                         |
| ------------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `startup_ms` | number  | Milliseconds from launch to the first drawn canvas. |
| `card_count` | integer | Cards on the canvas it opened to.                   |

### performance_summarized

A summary of one timing over a session of the app or of `orion server start`, sent when the session ends. Sent by the app and the CLI.

| Property       | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `metric`       | string  | What was timed: a pan or zoom frame, a `derive` or `layout` pass, or a flush by `orion server start`. One of `pan_frame`, `zoom_frame`, `derive`, `layout`, `server_flush`. |
| `sample_count` | integer | How many times it was measured.                                                                                                                                             |
| `p50_ms`       | number  | The median, in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                                |
| `p95_ms`       | number  | The 95th percentile, in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                       |
| `max_ms`       | number  | The slowest, in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                               |
| `card_count`   | integer | Cards on the canvas when the summary was taken.                                                                                                                             |
| `group_count`  | integer | Groups on the canvas when the summary was taken.                                                                                                                            |

## Canvas shape

How big canvases get, so performance can be compared on canvases of the same size.

### canvas_measured

The size of a canvas, taken when it opens and at most once a day after that. Sent by the app.

| Property        | Type    | Description                                |
| --------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `card_count`    | integer | Cards.                                     |
| `group_count`   | integer | Groups.                                    |
| `nesting_depth` | integer | The most groups nested inside one another. |
| `link_count`    | integer | Dependency links.                          |
| `note_count`    | integer | Notes.                                     |
| `media_count`   | integer | Images and other media.                    |
| `sticker_count` | integer | Stickers.                                  |
| `comment_count` | integer | Comments.                                  |

## Feature use

Which parts of the app get used, counted per session.

### features_used

How much each feature was used during a session, sent when the session ends. Sent by the app.

| Property          | Type    | Description                                   |
| ----------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `session_ms`      | number  | How long the session lasted, in milliseconds. |
| `select_tool_ms`  | number  | Milliseconds with the Select tool active.     |
| `pan_tool_ms`     | number  | Milliseconds with the Pan tool active.        |
| `comment_tool_ms` | number  | Milliseconds with the Comment tool active.    |
| `sticker_tool_ms` | number  | Milliseconds with the Sticker tool active.    |
| `stickers_placed` | integer | Stickers placed.                              |
| `comments_left`   | integer | Comments left.                                |
| `groups_created`  | integer | Groups created.                               |
| `tidies`          | integer | Times the canvas was tidied.                  |
| `pastes`          | integer | Pastes onto the canvas.                       |

## Agent use

Which CLI commands and MCP tools run, so the agent surface can be shaped around real use.

### cli_command_ran

An `orion` command finished. Sent by the CLI.

| Property      | Type    | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `command`     | string  | The command's name, such as `card set`. Never its arguments.                                                   |
| `flags`       | string  | The names of the flags it was given, sorted and comma-separated, such as `--json,--where`. Never their values. |
| `duration_ms` | number  | How long it ran, in milliseconds.                                                                              |
| `exit_code`   | integer | The code it exited with.                                                                                       |
| `interactive` | boolean | Whether a terminal was attached, which tells a person typing from an agent running it.                         |

### mcp_tool_called

A tool served by `orion mcp start` finished. Sent by the MCP server.

| Property      | Type    | Description                                                            |
| ------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tool`        | string  | The tool's name, such as `orion_card_set`. Never its arguments.        |
| `client`      | string  | The name the MCP client gave when it connected, such as `claude-code`. |
| `duration_ms` | number  | How long it ran, in milliseconds.                                      |
| `failed`      | boolean | Whether the call failed.                                               |
